scenes.say: Every day, people send over three hundred billion emails. So how does one actually reach you?
scenes.title: How does *email* reach you?
scenes.subtitle: A 30-second tour

scenes.say: First, your app hands the message to an outgoing server. That server looks up where the recipient lives, then passes it along to their inbox server.
scenes.heading: The journey

scenes.say: Think of it like a postal service, but every hop takes milliseconds instead of days.
That's email in thirty seconds. Follow for more quick explainers.
scenes.title: Email, explained
